text:
sophie: Incoming pen-test intake PT-855 (drop in bucket). Short: staging CMK grants a CI role decrypt, Dedicated machines missing SSM transcript objects, and our API layer drops request bodies from logs. Need triage, short mitigation, and retest ask.
michael: path?
sophie: s3://redwood-pt/reports/PT-855/2026-03-28/report.pdf
kevin: noted. Which alias?
sophie: alias/redwood/staging-enc. Policy shows principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-runner with Decrypt.
michael: mitigation plan (quick): 1) create new CMK + alias staging-enc-v2 2) remove ci-runner from old key policy 3) re-encrypt any sensitive objects and update TF backend. Hot-swap ok if we run a canary.
kevin: I'll own the KMS side and terraform drift. Runbook snippet I'll use: ```aws kms create-key --description "pt-855 staging v2" && aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/staging-enc-v2 --target-key-id <id>``` then patch policy and `aws kms re-encrypt` for state.
oncall: pick a window and I'll page SRE. Prefer after-midnight.
sophie: logging fixes: enable SSM Session Manager to push transcripts to s3://redwood-pt/ssm-transcripts/ and add a security-only retention lock; for API bodies route flagged requests to a separate archival pipeline with scrubber.
michael: evidence checklist for vendor retest: key creation CloudTrail event, policy before/after diff, re-encrypt logs, sample SSM transcript object (redacted), API archive object metadata (SHA256), and a short replay script output.
sec-bot: Ticket created PT-855-REMED (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-855-REMED) :page_with_curl:
kevin: owners: KMS+TF -> kevin, SSM transcripts -> michael, API archival -> sophie. Proposed maintenance tonight 01:45-03:00 UTC.
michael: I'm available for 01:45-02:45, will validate transcripts with a dummy session: ```aws ssm start-session --target i-0abcde12345 --document-name AWS-StartInteractiveCommand``` then check s3 prefix sessions/{instance}/{ts}.
kevin: I'll run canary re-encrypt and update backend. If re-encrypt fails we rollback alias. I'll paste exact terraform commands in the ticket.
oncall: pager ready for the window.
sophie: retest request to vendor: 1) attempt the reported decryption/escalation against staging (timeboxed) 2) verify SSM transcripts contain commands and are read-restricted, 3) confirm archived API bodies show no tamper vector. Proposed retest: tomorrow 08:30-10:00 UTC.
michael: sending vendor note now, attaching interim evidence links. Keep status pings short in thread during the window. :white_check_mark:
